item.title: Non v1 leaders
item.description:
Source: TW

– Shri Kanaka Dāsa was one of the most famous Shudra Mādhva Gurus – Several disciples of Shri Vādirājaru, Shri Tande Muddu Mohana Dāsa, etc., were from “untouchable” castes and became Mādhvas – The same Shri Vishvesha Teertharu forcibly made lower caste people enter a temple when they were denied entry! – He gave sannyāsa dīksha to my own Guru who was a Kshatriya in his pūrvāshrama – He gave dīksha to multiple “untocuhables” even recently. – His successor, Shri Vishvaprasanna Teertharu, is also continuing the tradition. – Even today, there are ample non-Brahmin Mādhvas, including Shudras
